violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Soda crates in kitchen observed used for raising Canola oil containers from floor.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EHS discussed removal of all crates and replace with proper NSF storage containers as needed. PIC removed soda crates and moved Canola oil container to the shelf.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS instructed PIC to clean out the mop heads, rinse them, and hang up the mops to air dry.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that ceiling panels in the kitchen are not maintained in good repair in some locations. Observed small gaps in the panels or missing all together (above the kitchen handwashing sink).) Observed broken tiles behind water heater.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS discussed getting the ceiling panels replaced above the kitchen handwashing sink, sealing up any small gaps between the panels, repairing tiles behind water heater. PIC will email proof of repair to EHS once upon completion.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed raw chicken thawing under room temperature next to dishwasher machine.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC completely submerged raw chicken under running water in prep sink.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Observed the chemical dispensing system of the low-temperature dish machine is not functioning properly. Observed the final rinse sanitizer concentration at 0ppm in dishwasher machine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC replaced the sanitizer supply bucket. The final rinse sanitizer concentration is now 50ppm

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: EHS observed unsalted butter ( 69F) and garlic butter being held on the counter out of refrigeration longer than 4 hrs.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC disposed of butter agreed to either use time as a public health control, cold hold butter or hot hold butter.

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Operated per Data Plate
violations.observation: The mechanical warewashing machine was not operating in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications. EHS observed dish machine in the bar area not being able to dispense chlorine sanitizer
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine and its auxiliary components shall be operated in accordance with the machine's data plate and other manufacturer's instructions. PIC primed dish machine, ran dish machine three times and then tested to make sure chlorine met minimum requirements.
